original.target_description: Parental occupational social status (ISEI) association with preference for care by family members versus childcare center, alternative-specific conditional logit model 2. Sample: parents/household partners with at least one child in center-based care in Bern, Switzerland.

n.sample_role: Participants/respondents (parents or household partners), represented by 1620 alternative-level observations in the choice model.
n.exclusions: Table 4 uses 200 imputations of missing values, rather than listwise deletion. Section 3.3.3 reports 54 missing outcome observations and 38 missing ISEI values; these were imputed. No further exclusion is specified for this table.
n.location: p. 117 (PDF p. 8), Table 4, N (Observations) and note; p. 115 (PDF p. 6), section 3.3.3

notes: Published article title and authors match the assigned reference. Table 4 labels estimates as odds ratios. Parentheses give standard errors, not test statistics. No numerical p-value or explicit p-bound is printed for the selected unstarred coefficient; no p-value was calculated. Original-only validation: replication and reported_success were not examined. Model 2 is the first adjusted model containing ISEI and no subsidy interaction; the locator supplies no model number. Table 4 also prints ISEI coefficients in models 3–5, which add separate interaction terms.
